scripts.build: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter web build
scripts.build:cloudflare: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter web build:cloudflare
scripts.check: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @interactive-inc/emdash-plugins --filter web check
scripts.test:integration: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @interactive-inc/emdash-plugins test:integration && vp run --filter web test
scripts.test:all: vp run test && vp run test:integration
scripts.verify: vp run --filter @interactive-inc/emdash-plugins check && vp run test
scripts.release: vp run check && vp run test:all && vp run build && vp run build:cloudflare && vp run test:package
